name: dobe_v4_34L
desc: Official idle sprite of this exact pink paint goo Doberman character, pixel art, true three-quarter view: the whole body is turned about 45 degrees toward the left, the near (left) shoulder and arm forward and larger, the far shoulder and arm partly hidden behind the broad chest, chest seen at an angle, head also turned to the left in three-quarter view with the muzzle pointing left. Standing idle, relaxed but intimidating. Keep the base sprite's body proportions, broad soft chest, colors, yellow marble streaks, outline and shading. Face: yellow human-like eyes with a dark pupil, slightly half-lidded; the mouth is closed with the corner of the mouth curled up just a little into a sly, lewd smirk; a little drool. The muzzle is smooth and plain: NO line or groove between the nose and the mouth, the area under the nose is clean pink. Lower body melts into a tall goo column and a wide glossy puddle. Crisp pixel art, dark outline, big wet highlights, transparent background.
refs: the character to draw: copy its design, body proportions, colors, marble pattern and pixel art style exactly, but turn it into a three-quarter view facing left
character design front view: chest, face and marble
character design side view: head and muzzle profile, body depth
